## Part 1


```{r}
triad_pattern <- vector(mode = "character", length = length(letters) - 2L)
for (i in 1:(length(letters) - 2L)) {
  triad <- paste0(letters[i], letters[i + 1L], letters[i + 2L])
  triad_pattern[i] <- triad
}

next_letter <- function(l) {
  if ((which(letters == l)) == 26) {
    return("a")
  } else {
    return(letters[(which(letters == l)) + 1L])
  }
}
```


```{r}
check_pairs <- function(p) {
  pairs <- str_extract_all(p, "([a-z])\\1")[[1]]
  length(pairs) >= 2
}


check_password <- function(passwd) {
  straight <- str_detect(passwd, paste(triad_pattern, collapse = '|'))
  forbidden <- str_detect(passwd, "[iol]", negate = TRUE)
  pairs <- check_pairs(passwd)
  all(straight, forbidden, pairs)
}

check_password("hijklmmn") # FALSE
check_password("abbceffg") # FALSE

rotate_passwd <- function(passwd, old, rightmost) {
  p <- str_split_1(passwd, '')
  new <- p
  new[rightmost] <- next_letter(p[rightmost])
  if (
    paste0(
      new,
      collapse = ''
    ) ==
      old
  ) {
    rightmost <- rightmost - 1L
    new <- p
    new[rightmost] <- next_letter(p[rightmost])
    old <- paste0(new, collapse = '')
    message(paste("old ", old))
  }
  list(
    input = paste0(
      new,
      collapse = ''
    ),
    rightmost = rightmost,
    old = old
  )
}

counter <- 0
input <- "abcdefgh"
old <- input
rightmost <- nchar(input)
while (!check_password(input)) {
  counter <- counter + 1
  if (counter %% 10 == 0) {
    message(paste(old, input, counter, rightmost))
  }
  out <- rotate_passwd(input, old, rightmost)
  rightmost <- out$rightmost
  input <- out$input
  old <- out$old
  #if (check_password(input)) break
}


input <- "vzbxkghb"
```
